restMasked.note: Her masked pose, standing: the first frame of the halt take, which is the drawing.

restHeld.note: Her unmasked pose, standing: the first frame of the wag take.

haha.note: "...Ha, kidding." — the palm drops into ONE bounce of a laugh. Was 46-82, three bounces (head lows at frames 64, 70, 76); Richard: "we should only play the bouncing laugh once".

kidding.note: "kidding." — the shrug take's 1s-3s, palms up, held a beat, and BACK to her pose. Richard: "ping-pong the shrug animation at the end so that it ends at RestMasked like we started".

beckon.note: "Come closer" — a beckon, and back to her pose.

mask.note: The helmet going on, peace sign to fist on hip. Played backwards it is the helmet coming OFF.

pointUp.note: "Look up." — from her pose, up, and HELD with the fingertip in frame.

pointPose.note: Strikes a pose, then points straight up and holds — the point take from its 1s mark. Richard: "starting at about the 1s mark so that she strikes a pose before smoothly transitioning to the pointUp animation".

wagTalk.note: Talking — the wag take's first two seconds. Richard: "a talking animation like payne_wag_999697c0.mp4 has at the first 2 seconds".

thumb.note: "Payne." / "Me?" — a thumb at herself, and back.

count.note: One finger, then two: counting the job off.
